actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The repository has a simulator in simulate_python, implemented on pnd_sdk_python and mujoco, and the MJCF description files of the supported robots in pnd_robots
The simulator loads the scene named by config.ROBOT_SCENE with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path
config.py composes ROBOT_SCENE from ROBOT, whose default is adam_u_omnipicker; adam_lite, adam_pro and adam_sp are the other listed names
The simulator overwrites model.opt.timestep with config.SIMULATE_DT
The simulator advances the world with mujoco.mj_step in its physics loop
The card's main model is the MJCF scene pnd_robots/adam_lite/scene.xml, whose root element is <mujoco model="adam_lite scene">
The scene includes the robot model adam_lite.xml and sets the option timestep to 0.001 s
The robot model is rooted at <mujoco model="adam_lite">
The robot's base is a free joint named floating_joint, so the model has a floating base (7 qpos and 6 qvel values) before the 23 hinge joints
The model defines 23 <motor> actuators: 12 leg, 3 waist and 4 per arm; the two wristYaw motors are commented out
The leg motor control ranges are hipPitch and kneePitch +-230, hipRoll +-160, hipYaw +-105, anklePitch +-40 and ankleRoll +-12
The waist motor control ranges are +-110, the shoulder ranges +-65 and the elbow ranges +-30

The model defines joint position, joint velocity and joint actuator force sensors for the actuated joints, plus an IMU at site imu (frame quaternion, gyro, accelerometer, frame position and linear velocity)
The README advertises MuJoCo 3.2.0 and Python 3.8 or newer

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state, and a reset restores the model defaults; the bridge takes no seed that selects a different state, so equal initial states repeat but no seed varies them

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the scene for the joint dimensions, the actuator count, the control ranges and the 1 ms timestep, but it integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated hinge and applies no gravity, contact, equality, tendon or muscle model
no mesh or texture of the asset directories is loaded by the stand-in, and no collision or visual geometry is resolved

MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine; the upstream simulator's viewer, elastic hoist, joystick and DDS/ROS2 bridges are not modelled either
no physical Adam-Lite robot is modelled by this driver and nothing was validated against the hardware

measures.name: time_ms

measures.description: Control vector last applied to the actuators (ctrl)
measures.name: ctrl

measures.description: Integration steps since the last reset
measures.name: tick

measures.description: Integration step of the model (null when the model states none)
measures.name: timestep_ms

measures.description: Seed the bridge was configured with

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
